title: Implement the logical BIT outer borrowing wrapper
body:
## Summary

Implement PR2786's released outer-wrapper handoff in `research/selected-outer-borrowing-wrapper/`:

```text
swap residual digits, if present
D -= H
pad -> completed unweighted F_I -> restrict
D += H
pad -> completed unweighted F_I -> restrict
D = H - D
swap the original high fields
```

The new result is executable binary-tape composition, an ordered-layout/ownership proof and an explicit added-cost ledger. Padding each F separately keeps fabricated row ordinals out of high-field arithmetic. Nondivisible stock, overborrowing, residual digits and arbitrary original spectators are covered under the stated completed-callee contract.

The ordinary-wrapper identity and conditional stock argument remain predecessor results. No selected frontier, stock coefficient, cutoff or kappa changes.

Contribution commit: `b00b58e0db823643364f705b530faac254e7b05b`. [Proof, code, pins and receipts](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/b00b58e0db823643364f705b530faac254e7b05b/research/selected-outer-borrowing-wrapper).

## Evidence

- Before, PR2786 explicitly leaves the enclosing high-part wrapper open. After, nine literal interface fixtures check all **38,925 Boolean input columns**, plus every individual completed F endpoint and the actual added pass counts.
- The unchanged source Node/Driver executes the full one-family GL2(F2) toy: 8 genuine rows padded separately to 12, all 1,024 genuine columns, 24 MOVE residuals and **240 matched child returns**. This is not selected GL64 execution; its program is an opaque toy token, not a serialized coefficient program.
- Nine controls detect omitted/wrong shears, missing high/remainder exchange, wrong F semantics, unsafe weighted-F substitution and failures at either callee entry. Nine CLI tests cover source/receipt corruption, bytecode/preload rejection, optimized Git-free read-only replay and emission boundaries.
- Registered normal and optimized CPython 3.12.15 replays pass on Linux x86_64. All 74 research-workflow tests, scoped Ruff and whitespace checks pass. No hosted-CI, formal-kernel or independent human review is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/selected-outer-borrowing-wrapper
```

Sources are pinned to Nick Petalas's PR2786 `80df2062cef303c05ffe89bb54b87b6b371d1253` and David Arias's PR2753 `7dba5452a4071a856a0b11cebdcd2d3b6bcd7659`. Five exact padding exports and the complete 84-file caller archive authenticate before import. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2697/2234 source/caller lineage, Sagar Thakrar's conditional body-stock argument and all retained source notices. Apache-2.0.

The completed selected odd-prime GL64 interface, S/k construction and fit, fixed physical tapes/movement, total reserve and stronger H2 time bounds remain open. The README gives bounded next steps; this component does not justify another supplier search.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18959721). `TASK.json` records priority revision 5, the explicit scope change from reserve arithmetic and final upstream/overlap freshness. The scientific source pins remain immutable.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way

Additive, opt-in research package. Frozen predecessors, production verifier defaults and the selected result are untouched.

**Blast radius:** research
